resources.string: A run pings the server ten times, then downloads for the time set here, then uploads for the same time. The headline numbers leave out the first fifth of each transfer, where the connections are still opening.
How long the download and the upload each run. Longer is steadier and costs more data.
Requests in flight together. One connection rarely fills a fast line; four is what the browser tests use.
Off, a run is pings and download only, and takes half the time and data.
The picture a result is sent as. The same choices sit on the panel as chips, and either place changes both.
Only the Sticker size can go as a sticker, and only into apps that take one. The other sizes are always pictures.
Save sent cards to the gallery
A copy of every card you send goes into Pictures/WM Keyboard. The panel\'s Save button saves one whether this is on or not.
Put the connection\'s public address in the card\'s footer. Off, the card names only the network and the server.
A run goes to the server chosen on the panel. Cloudflare needs nothing set up. A LibreSpeed server is one you run yourself, or one picked from the public list of volunteers\' servers on its row.
About a hundred volunteers\' servers, listed at librespeed.org. Picking one fills in this row\'s address.
A server near you gives the truest numbers. The list is fetched from librespeed.org when this opens.
The list could not be fetched. Type the server\'s address under Setup instead.
